title: Prove Live Backend Rich Inline Mutation
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repositories, Checklist target, and Evidence target before editing Editor.
The harness requires Editor production UI or WYSIWYG authoring behavior to be enabled before its boundary is defined.
The harness bypasses the Backend mutation route or applies a local-only Core mutation as evidence for live Backend compatibility.
The harness copies Backend or Core semantics into Editor instead of using the existing Editor backend mutation request and runtime apply boundaries.
The focused rich-inline path or full Editor owner gate fails after the implementation.
Cleanup side effects leave Core, Backend, Editor, or Project Control in a dirty or unverified state.
Project Control promotes broad FlowDoc, Core, Backend, Editor, frontend, or map truth from this bounded harness.
verificationTarget: The Editor live compatibility harness uses the real loopback Backend client path for a rich-inline text-block replacement, applies the returned Core-backed mutation result through Editor runtime state, blocks stale replay, and records the result without broad truth promotion.
summary: Done: Editor commit 3b592b48765337efdbd6da539130d2daae1349bc adds the bounded live Backend rich-inline harness and passes focused, worktree, merged-main, and cleanup verification gates.
